title: One digest per wave instead of status messages
what: `relay digest [--since <sha or date>]` builds, from git (merges on the default branch, their queue closes) and the queue (open counts, owner decisions recorded, items added), one page for the owner: what changed for them in plain words, the front's decisions the owner can reverse, numbers (merged, open fix/feature, paid spend), open questions. The front sends it once per wave of merges and stays silent between, except for a real choice, the default branch going red, a spend jump, or a block only the owner can lift. The rule and the front skill say so; the per-event status line goes.
why: Owner, 25 Oct: "я зачастую не отслеживаю то что ты делаешь, в этом суть автономности, но от этого появляется пробел в моем понимании происходящего, необходимо найти способ его восполнять без подобных запросов, или же изменить способ общения с тобой, где я только обозначаю стратегию"; then "1. a" (strategy from the owner, a digest per wave, only real questions). About 30 status messages on 25 Oct, none answering "what changed for me". IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).

fact: Edited where: folder entry named as a file (found 28 Oct, refuse-folder-and-pattern-entries-in-where)

Front decision (owner can reverse; principle 9: a decision that follows from the principles is made and reported afterwards), 30 Oct: the design's open question 'when does a decision the front took alone reach the owner' is answered a, as principle 9 already says: one line per item when its decisions are recorded (5 to 10 a day, grouped by item), work goes on; b (only in the wave digest) would report most decisions after they landed; c (every decision waits) would hold 5 to 10 items a day, median 8 min, p90 2.4 h. Reviewed design rev 2 (8 of 8 findings held and fixed): what is new comes from the git diff of the queue between the head of the last sent digest and now; `relay digest` only prints, `--sent` records delivery; `relay digest --due` plus an end-of-turn hook say when a digest or spend alert is due; every decision note counts (about 27 a day, up to about 50, an upper estimate); the 32 earlier plain-text decisions are shown once.

question: The digest change is ready (review open 0, gate green) and stopped before landing because it changes what the owner reads: land it as shown in the live preview of 30 Oct?
options: a. land it as it is; wording fixes come as fix items
b. hold it; the owner names what to change first
reading: b: hold the digest change (wt/one-digest-per-wave-instead-of-status-me) before landing; the owner names what to change first.
